title: How close can rational points get to a manifold?
summary: We prove the heuristically predicted lower bound for the number of rational points of height at most $Q$ lying within $ε/Q$ of a fixed analytic nondegenerate manifold in $\mathbb{R}^n$, provided that $ε\asymp Q^{-τ}$ for some $τ\leq 3/(2m+1)$, where $m$ is the codimension of the manifold. Our result establishes the lower bound well beyond the previously conjectured range $τ\leq 1/m$, and improves upon a recent result of Schindler, Srivastava, and Technau, who established the same lower bound for $τ\leq 3/(2n-1)$.
